mapper.select: WITH member_stats AS ( SELECT count(*) AS members, count(*) FILTER (WHERE last_login_at >= now() - interval '7 days') AS active_members, count(*) FILTER (WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '7 days') AS new_members, COALESCE(sum(credit_balance), 0) AS credit_balance FROM users WHERE is_deleted = false ), publication_stats AS ( SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'PUBLISHED') AS published, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'DRAFT') AS drafts, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'PUBLISHED' AND access_type = 'CREDIT') AS paid FROM publications WHERE is_deleted = false ), comment_stats AS ( SELECT count(*) AS comments FROM comments WHERE is_deleted = false AND status = 'PUBLISHED' ), unlock_stats AS ( SELECT count(*) AS unlocks FROM content_unlocks WHERE is_deleted = false ), credit_stats AS ( SELECT COALESCE(-sum(delta), 0) AS credits_spent FROM credit_ledger_entries WHERE reason = 'SPEND' ) SELECT m.members, m.active_members, m.new_members, p.published, p.drafts, p.paid, c.comments, u.unlocks, l.credits_spent, m.credit_balance FROM member_stats m CROSS JOIN publication_stats p CROSS JOIN comment_stats c CROSS JOIN unlock_stats u CROSS JOIN credit_stats l

SELECT d.day::date AS date, (SELECT count(*) FROM users u WHERE u.is_deleted = false AND u.created_at >= d.day AND u.created_at < d.day + interval '1 day') AS registrations, (SELECT count(*) FROM publications p WHERE p.is_deleted = false AND p.published_at >= d.day AND p.published_at < d.day + interval '1 day') AS publications, (SELECT count(*) FROM comments c WHERE c.is_deleted = false AND c.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND c.created_at >= d.day AND c.created_at < d.day + interval '1 day') AS comments FROM generate_series(current_date - 6, current_date, interval '1 day') AS d(day) ORDER BY d.day

SELECT l.id::text AS id, u.email, u.nickname, l.delta, l.balance_after, l.reason, l.note, l.created_at FROM credit_ledger_entries l JOIN users u ON u.id = l.user_id ORDER BY l.created_at DESC, l.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
